store.summary: Ham radio shack calculators: band privileges, Ohm's law, dB, SWR, coax loss, grid squares, UTC
store.description: From Ask Elmer, askelmer.com. The everyday ham radio calculators in your pocket, offline. Frequency and band: type a frequency or wavelength, pick Technician, General or Extra, and see the band, whether you may transmit there and with which modes, the wavelength, and half- and quarter-wave lengths. Band plan: every US band with your class's segments (FCC Part 97). Ohm's law: any two of volts, amps, ohms and watts, with prefixes like 4.7k. Decibels: watts to dBm and dBW, gains and losses, ratios. SWR: from a reading or forward and reflected watts, with reflected power, return loss and mismatch loss. Coax loss: RG-58, RG-8X, RG-213 and LMR-400 at any length and frequency. Grid square: your Maidenhead locator from latitude and longitude, and distance and beam heading to another grid. A big UTC clock with your log time, phonetics for any call sign, and the common Q signals. Your entries are kept for next time. Fn+H shows help.
